crucifix.line: You held on to me like I was a crucifix
stanza: We met when we were almost young
Deep in the green lilac park
You held on to me like I was a crucifix
As we went kneeling through the dark

lunatics.line: But they threw me in the mix with all these gloomy lunatics
lunatics.linePrev: Or comfortable and roomy in a 6
lunatics.lineNext: Who walk around depressed, and smoke a pound of cess a day
